title: Copiotrophs dominate rhizosphere microbiomes and growth rate potential is a major factor explaining the rhizosphere effect
authors: López JL; Pappas N; Poppeliers SW; Sanchez-Gil JJ; Fourie-Fouche A; de Jonge R; Dutilh BE
one_liner_zh: 该文研究根际微生物组中细菌生长速率潜力与功能特征，未涉及蛋白质-DNA互作、转录因子结合或AI/物理模拟建模，与本课题无关。
abstract: The structure and function of the root microbial community is shaped by plant root activity, enriching specific microbial taxa and functions from the surrounding soil as the plant root grows. Knowledge of bacterial rhizosphere competence traits are important for predictive microbiome modeling and the development of viable bioinoculants for sustainable agriculture solutions. In this work we compared growth rate potential, a complex trait that recently became predictable from bacterial genome sequences, to functional traits encoded by proteins. We analyzed 84 paired rhizosphere- and soil-derived 16S rRNA metabarcoding datasets from 18 different plants and soil types, performed differential abundance analyses and estimated growth rates for each bacterial genus. This analysis revealed that bacteria with a high growth rate potential consistently dominated the rhizosphere. Next, we analyzed the genome sequences of 3270 bacterial isolates and 6707 MAGs from 1121 plant- and soil-associated metagenomes, confirming this trend in different bacterial phyla. We next investigated which functional traits were enriched in the rhizosphere, expanding the catalog of rhizosphere-associated traits with hundreds of new functions. When we compared the importance of different functional categories to the predicted growth rate potential using a machine learning model, we found that growth rate potential was the main feature for differentiating rhizosphere and soil bacteria, revealing the broad importance of this factor for explaining the rhizosphere effect. Together, we contribute new understanding of the bacterial traits needed for rhizosphere competence. As this trait may be inferred from (meta-) genome data, our work has implications for understanding bacterial community assembly in the rhizosphere, where many uncultivated bacteria reside.
abstract_zh: 根微生物群落的结构与功能受植物根系活动的影响，随着植物根系的生长，会从周围土壤中富集特定的微生物类群和功能。了解细菌根际竞争能力特征对于预测性微生物组建模以及开发可持续农业解决方案中的可行生物接种剂至关重要。在本研究中，我们将生长速率潜力（一种近期可从细菌基因组序列预测的复杂性状）与由蛋白质编码的功能性状进行了比较。我们分析了来自18种不同植物和土壤类型的84对根际和土壤来源的16S rRNA宏条形码数据集，进行了差异丰度分析，并估算了每个细菌属的生长速率。该分析揭示，具有高生长速率潜力的细菌持续主导根际。接下来，我们分析了来自1121个植物和土壤相关宏基因组的3270个细菌分离株和6707个MAG的基因组序列，确认了这一趋势在不同细菌门中的普遍性。随后，我们研究了哪些功能性状在根际中富集，将根际相关性状目录扩展了数百种新功能。当我们使用机器学习模型比较不同功能类别对预测生长速率潜力的重要性时，发现生长速率潜力是区分根际和土壤细菌的主要特征，揭示了该因素在解释根际效应中的广泛重要性。综合来看，我们为根际竞争能力所需的细菌性状提供了新的理解。由于该性状可从（宏）基因组数据中推断，我们的工作对理解根际中细菌群落组装具有重要意义，而根际中栖息着许多未培养的细菌。
